subject.title: Add a retraction window for forwarded exec approvals (agent-cancellable hold before prompt delivery)

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in forwarded exec approval hold/retract contract, and where should the agent-visible retraction authority live?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing this behavior changes safety-sensitive approval timing, public config, Gateway protocol, and Codex/native decision semantics.

options.title: Design opt-in hold/retract
options.body: Add `holdMs` and a narrow retract/cancel contract with fail-open delivery to humans, fail-closed execution to agents, audit logging, docs, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Decline this approval mode
options.body: Keep immediate forwarding as the product contract and direct users to existing allowlists, approval modes, or approval-routing cleanup for prompt noise.

options.title: Defer into approval redesign
options.body: Keep this issue open as design input but implement it only as part of a broader approval-routing and native approval contract refresh.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in hold/retract
recommendation.body: Add `holdMs` and a narrow retract/cancel contract with fail-open delivery to humans, fail-closed execution to agents, audit logging, docs, and compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history in the shared approval delivery path and current approval-forwarder blame among the inspected owners.
